notes: Do-file lines 36-42: use pcaob_it_analysis; merge m:1 gvkey year using inte_audit; drop if _m==2; inte=0 if missing; keep if inte==1; reghdfe breach_info it_insp, a(year firm_aud) cl(auditor_fkey). Published value = authors code re-run on package data (Stata MP 16 reghdfe: -0.0065263 (0.002824), N 42,789 after 1,207 singletons; fixest identical; article text not in the project). Sample 43,996 pair-years, 7,606 client-auditor pairs, 306 auditors (24 ever cited), 2004-2016. it_insp is monotone within pair with no switch-offs (switchoff is identically 0, the filter is inert). g_pair = first year with it_insp==1 for the 409 pairs that switch inside their observed history; for the 6,291 pairs already treated at entry it is the auditor-level it_insp_year floored at 2004 (5,879 pairs are always treated in 2004-2016, 412 enter the panel after their auditor was cited); 906 pairs never treated. 1[year>=g_pair]==it_insp on every row (asserted in _work/build_gvar.R). it_insp differs from 1[year>=it_insp_year] on 462 rows (it_insp=0 after the auditor inspection year), which the authors indicator, not the inspection year, governs. Cohorts with untreated pre-period rows: 2005-2016 (11 years, 409 pairs). Rare binary outcome (mean 0.0153), clusters = 306 auditors.
